verdicts.reason: Both break the core image: the pale circle sits empty on the far left while the can floats alone on the right. Both also put the GLACIER wordmark below the headline and shrink the 'Find It Near You' CTA to the same tiny size as the two badges, so the call to action is buried. A at least lines its button row up with the headline's left edge. In B the buttons stick out to the left of the text column and sit almost on the bottom edge, and the can drops lower too, so B is slightly worse.
